meaning: OSM restaurants whose own-site quote the drink classifier accepts but which a reviewer found does not say this restaurant pours: a line about another venue of the group, a shop, a class, a delivery service or a consultancy. The harvest never publishes an excluded osmId, and validateRestaurantDrinksPack refuses a pack that holds one, so build:london-venues and --check fail on it. Hand-written.
